title: Progression
summary: Frame it right (thank goodness for a little bit of mounded up greenery on adjacent still-to-be-developed land), and you can give the impression of a grayscale urban environment, even when a more expansive view would show actual trees and plenty of sky. In this carefully composed shot though, black-clad condo towers angled to hide the airy gaps between them, form the backdrop for new townhomes, clad in a progression of shades from light to dark — not all grays, but some earth tones in there too — that smartly jibe with our perception of light being close and darkness further away.
